title: docs(skills): the data skill teaches field-change values as on by default
body:
Fixes #36419

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用 AI 建数据模型的人,AI 不再把“字段改动前后的值”当成要手动打开的功能;它现在知道这项默认就开,并知道在对象或单个字段上怎么关。
- 为什么做:平台已把字段变更值改成默认显示(“字段变更值默认显示”那项改动),对外发布的数据建模技能还在教旧说法,这次补齐。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是 AI 多写或少写一个历史开关;只改技能文字,不动任何运行逻辑,撤回本次合并即可恢复。
- 要你做什么:这是对外发布的技能文字,需要你审过后亲手合并。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, section "Object Capabilities (`enable`)" — the only place in `skills/objectstack-data/**` that taught field history as opt-in (`trackHistory`, default `false`, "Field-level audit trail").

- New `fieldHistory` row (default: on). A changed field's old → new values show on the activity timeline, served per the reader's field read rule. `false` turns them off for the object. A field opts out with its own `fieldHistory: false`; a media or structured field (`json`, `address`, `code` and the like) shows values only with `true`; a credential never. `sys_audit_log` keeps its own grant.
- `trackHistory` row rewritten to what the flag still does: the ledger view on the record page and the `history` API verb, and that it is not the values switch.
- Card item 2 said the ledger is "admin only". The dispatch order corrects that reading (a read-only viewer's wildcard grant reads the ledger object too), so the row says the ledger keeps its own grant and names no audience.
- Card item 1 as corrected by the card's own correction comment: the per-field off switch is `fieldHistory: false`, not `trackHistory: false`.
- `references/examples-objects.md` keeps `enable.trackHistory: true`: it is still valid (the ledger view) and is not an opt-in claim about values.

Paid for in the same file (token ratchet, ceiling not moved):

- `aiReadable` row cut to what an app author needs: platform objects only, refused at parse on an app object, `false` included. The list of verbs and the two excluded platform objects are dropped; an app object can never declare the key.
- Restating phrases shortened: the `feeds` and `activities` rows ("opt-out: explicit" beside a `true` default), `sharingModel` ("absence is not a decision" after "refused"), `nameField` ("Canonical"), `fieldGroups`, `label`, `files`, `datasource`, the `lifecycle` default cell, "not by habit", "not silently dropped" after "refused", and the mirror-maintenance sentence.

| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` lines | 471 | 471 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` tokens (ratchet's count) | 6706 | 6709 (ceiling 6710) |
| All `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines | 4947 | 4947 |
| All `skills/*/SKILL.md` tokens (sum of the ratchet's rows) | 65222 | 65225 |

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, the `fieldHistory` and `trackHistory` rows: every clause against `packages/spec/src/data/field-history-default.ts` (`resolveFieldHistory`) and the `enable.fieldHistory` / field `fieldHistory` descriptions in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` and `field.zod.ts`.
2. The same file, the `aiReadable` row: confirm the dropped detail is not needed by an app author.
3. `.changeset/36419-skills-field-history-default.md`.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md is 6709 tokens (ceiling 6710; headroom 1)` and exits 0; `git grep -n trackHistory -- skills/objectstack-data` shows the rewritten row, the quick-start example, and one eval `must_not_contain` entry.

## Tests

Wording-only diff on a published skill; no behaviour under test changed, so no ablation. All readings on head `710841dae1`.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance "no sentence in `skills/objectstack-data/**` describes field history as opt-in": `git grep -n -i -E 'trackHistory|fieldHistory' -- skills/objectstack-data` now returns the two rewritten rows, the quick-start example's `enable.trackHistory: true` (ledger view, valid) and one eval `must_not_contain` entry. No other file in the skill states a history default.
- The skill evals were not edited; no eval asserts the old row.
- Noted, not fixed here: two refusal texts in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (the retired `enable.trash` and `versioning` keys) still send an author to per-field `trackHistory` "for field-level history". On a field whose values already show, that flag changes nothing.

## Verification

- Premise re-read on `origin/main` `70f454a23c` before the edit: the old row was at `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:110`; the contract is `enable.fieldHistory` (absent: values show; `false`: off for the object) plus the field's own `fieldHistory`.
- CI families are read from this PR's check runs; none re-run locally beyond the list above.
